content: Python atomic write: write to tempfile in same directory as target (ensures same filesystem), then os.replace(tmp, target). os.replace() is atomic rename on POSIX. Same-dir temp ensures no cross-filesystem rename failure. Pattern: import tempfile, os; with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile('w', dir=os.path.dirname(target), delete=False, suffix='.tmp') as f: f.write(data); os.replace(f.name, target). For D-08: vault_sweeper writes temp in same ops/sweeps/ dir.
